title: Stage 02 Scenario
description: Exact learner-facing scenario plus explicit variable, unit, and decision metadata.

scenarioId.description: Scenario identifier copied exactly from Stage 01.

scenarioName.description: Homepage scenario name copied from Stage 01.

variables.description: Definitions of every symbol needed by the learner.

units.description: All units used in the scenario and calculations.

decision.description: The contextual decision, interpretation, or requirement the learner must answer.

constraint.description: The governing constraint, interval, relationship, or theorem conditions.

plotDataSrc.description: Empty for CONSTRUCTED, otherwise the scenario-specific plot-data path.

scenarioImageSrc.description: Optional path to an existing learner-facing illustration.

symbol.description: Symbol used in the mathematical model.

meaning.description: Plain-language quantity represented by the symbol.

unit.description: Unit of the represented quantity, or dimensionless when appropriate.

$comment: scenarioId, scenarioName, and representationType must equal Stage 01. Learner-facing text must contain no em dash or first-person language, and every variable and unit used must be defined.
